title: Add calculation history feature to track previous results

requirements.summary: Display a calculation history section showing all previous calculations from the current session
acceptanceCriteria: History section is visible on the calculator interface
Each history entry shows the complete calculation (e.g., '5 + 3 = 8')
History persists during the current session
Most recent calculation appears at the top of the list

file_operations.description: Add state management for calculation history using useState hook to store an array of history entries. Create a CalculationHistory component section within the main calculator interface that displays the history list. Each entry should show the complete calculation string (e.g., 'operand1 operator operand2 = result'). Render the history section below or beside the calculator card. Display most recent calculations at the top using reverse chronological order.

requirements.summary: Update calculation history automatically when successful calculations are performed
acceptanceCriteria: History updates immediately after each operation button click
Only successful calculations are added to history
Invalid input attempts do not create history entries
Division by zero errors do not create history entries

file_operations.description: Modify the operation button handlers (add, subtract, multiply, divide) to append successful calculation results to the history state array. Add history entries only when calculations complete successfully (valid inputs and no errors). Include the operation type, operands, and result in each history entry object. Ensure division by zero errors and invalid input scenarios do not trigger history updates by checking validation conditions before adding entries.

requirements.summary: Add a clear history button to remove all calculation history entries
acceptanceCriteria: Clear button is clearly labeled and accessible
Clicking clear removes all history entries instantly
Clear button is disabled or hidden when history is empty
After clearing, the history section shows an appropriate empty state

file_operations.description: Add a clear history button within the history section. Implement a handler function that resets the history state to an empty array when clicked. Conditionally render the button only when history entries exist, or disable it when the history array is empty. Display an empty state message (e.g., 'No calculation history yet') when the history array is empty. Style the button consistently with existing operation buttons.

requirements.summary: Style the calculation history section with warm coral/orange color scheme matching the existing minimalist design
acceptanceCriteria: History section uses the same color palette as the calculator
Typography and spacing match existing design patterns
History entries are easy to read and well-organized

file_operations.description: Apply consistent styling to the calculation history section using the existing warm coral/orange color scheme defined in frontend/src/index.css. Use the same card-based layout pattern, typography (Inter font), spacing, and border radius values as the main calculator. Style history entries with appropriate padding, hover states, and text formatting for readability. Ensure the clear button matches the visual style of operation buttons. Maintain the modern, minimalist aesthetic throughout the history section.
